name: Metal Container Corporation - Arnold MO Can Plant

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed Metal Container Corporation (MCC) can plant, 42 Tenbrook Industrial Park, Arnold MO 63010 - AB-owned, the nation's largest can manufacturing operation. Roster coords were ~1.9 km off (movedMeters 1926). Locked center on the MCC manufacturing complex at 38.43380,-90.35350. Identity confirmed by web research (Yelp, TruckMap, EPA TRI facility 63010MTLCN42TEN) and the large manufacturing complex with extensive trailer yards in Tenbrook Industrial Park.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck gate positively identified. The plant sits inside a multi-tenant industrial park; W-side driveways are open paved access with cars parked, and the NE trailer yard is open dirt/gravel with no fence on the powerline-easement side. A slatted chain-link fence is present along part of the W edge but the driveways appear ungated - classified false (no checkpoint), flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth identified at any plant entrance. A brick structure exists near the W driveway but Street View confirms it belongs to the neighboring St. Louis County Health Department / Animal Control building, not MCC. False.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Open short approach from the industrial-park road to the plant docks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Trailers backed in along the SE and S building faces; ~35 estimated, 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large open dirt/gravel trailer yard on the NE side holding ~90 trailers; 50+ band, capacity ~160. dropYard true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on separate building faces.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs N-S along the E side of the industrial park; a spur appears to reach the property but a siding directly into the MCC building could not be positively confirmed - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: MCC operates a multi-building campus - main can manufacturing hall plus several ancillary/warehouse buildings.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Small-town industrial park in Arnold MO between residential neighborhoods and the Meramec River; edge-of-town setting - Rural.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified - flagged uncertain.

citations.claim: AB announced a $150M investment in its Metal Container Corporation Arnold, MO facility, doubling aluminum bottle capacity.
AB InBev buying back the 49.9% stake in its US metal container operations (seven facilities, six states) for ~$3B, Q1 2026, confirming continued AB operation including Arnold.

verification.rationale: AB-owned MCC can plant, Arnold MO; $150M expansion + Jan 2026 $3B network buyback confirm current self-operation; 2009 Ball divestiture involved different plants.
